If there is a high CA125 level, then you should get investigated for possible ovarian tumors. In the case of pancreatic cancer, it is suggested that you get an ultrasound scan of the abdomen done every year and also get CA19-9 levels tested. The CA19-9 is a tumor marker for pancreatic cancer and might help in predicting the possibility of the disease by doing a blood test. Hope I have answered your query. Let me know if I can assist you further. Regards, Dr. Chase Parker.
